issues.desc: background.md says default storyDir is docs/story/actives, but this repo actually uses .koala/story/actives. CHK-001 correctly says "under configured storyDir", so implementation should resolve the capsule dir from the active storyDir config, NOT the literal default mentioned in background. Advisory: ensure no hardcoded docs/story path leaks into capsule storage.

User explicitly worried about "cross-project changes without story evidence". The checklist provides the audit substrate (CHK-002 run.json records commands/evidence/process-event refs) but has no explicit cross-project-edit detection item. Acceptable given the stated projection-layer scope, but flag so this user concern is consciously deferred rather than silently dropped.

background.md 称 storyDir 默认是 docs/story/actives，但本仓配置 storyDir=.koala/story/actives（B-42c0 自身即存于此）。CHK-001 capsule 目录必须在运行时解析 config.storyDir，禁止 hardcode docs/story/actives，否则 capsule 会写错位置。PLAN 阶段 pin 解析后的路径。
OMX 在本 story 内未定义。虽是仓内常见概念（.omx/ volatile 日志、OMX 风格设计引用遍布 handlers 与 stack-layering.md），但 CHK-006 capsule_import_omx 引用它而未给一句话定义。PLAN/decision 应明确 .omx/ 是什么、import_omx 读哪些字段。

CHK-005/CHK-006 反复出现 non_authoritative import 与 evidence/authority 绑定，但 non_authoritative 的具体机械语义（capsule 可见但永不进入 gate evidence 采集）未在 background 锁定。PLAN/decision 须给出可验证定义，并在 CHK-006 测试中证明伪造 capsule/OMX import 不能满足 DONE gate。
